The lamp is an asset manufactured in a Lamp factory and is a product that can be sold for capital. A lamp is a device that produces visible light from electric currents. It is a common form of artificial lighting and is handy to modern society, providing interior lighting for buildings and exterior light for evening and nighttime activities. In technical usage, a replaceable component that produces light from electricity is called a lamp.
